text:
Aisha Khan: Noticed a sudden spike in duplicate onboarding tasks this morning (approx 420) tied to accounts with merged duplicate records. Seems related to the dedupe sync running last night + the playbook rule that fires when health_score is NULL.
Diego Rivera: Ugh. Do we have a repro query? suspect the dedupe job set primary_account_id but didn't copy the health_score, so playbook sees NULL and fires.
Aisha Khan: Quick grep: `SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE type='onboard' AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours' AND duplicate_of IS NOT NULL;` returns 423.
Priya Nair: If health_score not carried over on merge -> playbook triggers. We should either (1) make the merge copy health_score, or (2) change playbook to ignore health_score IS NULL unless explicitly set to trigger. Which is faster to stop noise?
Ben Liu: Short-term: change playbook to require `health_score IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 0` or explicit bucket. Long-term: update dedupe workflow to carry over latest non-null health signals.
playbook-bot: Current rule: `if account.health_score is null then trigger(onboarding)` — last modified 2025-01-09 by ops-admin.
Diego Rivera: Can we patch the playbook to use `health_score IS NULL AND account_age < 14_days`? That would avoid backfilling older merged accounts.
Aisha Khan: I don't love age-based heuristics for new customers that legitimately need onboarding. Alternative: require `owner_id IS NOT NULL AND health_bucket IS NULL` for trigger. That reduces duplicates when merged records lose scoring.
Priya Nair: Agreed. Also let's add an idempotency key when playbook creates tasks: `task_idempotency = concat('playbook:onboard:', account.id)` so duplicates are suppressed.
Ben Liu: Idempotency is quick to add in playbook runtime. I'll open a rollout PR and set it as a canary for cs-dev and then cs-stage.
Diego Rivera: Meanwhile, Aisha can we collect sample merged_account_ids? need to backfill health_score on primary record for those. SQL to find candidates:```sql
-- merged accounts missing health_score
SELECT primary_account_id, array_agg(id) as merged_ids, max(health_score) as max_score
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE duplicate_of IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY primary_account_id
HAVING max(health_score) IS NULL;
```
Aisha Khan: Running that now on prod read-replica. Expect ~1800 primary records missing score.
playbook-bot: Proposed mitigation: Temporarily add `suppress_duplicates=true` flag to playbook runtime for 3 hours. Use `/playbook flag set suppress_duplicates true --ttl 3h` to test.
Priya Nair: Can we also schedule a tidy job: backfill health_score using most recent engagement signals from `telemetry.last_active` and `usage.session_count`? We'll need mapping rules to convert to health_bucket.
Ben Liu: Example mapping we use in experiments: `if session_count >= 10 -> healthy; 3-9 -> at_risk; <3 -> needs_attention`. I'll draft mapping and include edge case for imported accounts.
Diego Rivera: For auditability add `cs_change_reason='merge_backfill_v1'` and `backfill_source='dedupe-run-2025-06'` to updates. Also write rollback SQL:```sql
UPDATE crm.accounts a
SET health_score = prev.score, health_bucket = prev.bucket
FROM (SELECT account_id, prev_score as score, prev_bucket as bucket FROM cs_audit.backfill_log WHERE run_id = 'merge_backfill_202506') prev
WHERE a.id = prev.account_id;
```
Aisha Khan: Action items: @Ben to PR idempotency + suppress flag rollout (canary -> stage -> prod) ; @Diego to run candidate query and export CSV; @Priya to prepare mapping and vet thresholds; @Aisha to run backfill window Sat 03:00 UTC and coordinate owners notifications.
Ben Liu: I'll target canary tonight 23:00 UTC and post results.
playbook-bot: Canary scheduled: playbook:onboard idempotency patch v0.2 -> cs-dev at 2025-06-05T23:00Z. No external notifications.
Priya Nair: Also adding a monitoring alert: if onboarding tasks created per hour > 50 and > 2x baseline, page cs-oncall.
Diego Rivera: CSV uploaded to https://drive.redwood.com/cs/merge_candidates_20250605.csv (preview restricted).
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone. If we see leftover duplicates after idempotency, escalate and we'll run a manual dedupe rollback. :pray:
